title: Jinsanjiang Silica Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Jinsanjiang Silica Materials Co., Ltd. is a Chinese silica-materials company focused on functional silica solutions across multiple end-use markets. While the reviewed official corporate site emphasizes broader silica and separator-related material systems, public industry reporting states that the company has developed aerogel products for thermal-insulation applications and is expanding those use cases.

Company Overview

The official site positions Jinsanjiang as a silica-materials solution provider with listed-company scale and industrial manufacturing capability. Public industry-source materials indicate that the company has also developed aerogel-related products as part of its broader silica technology platform.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with wider advanced-materials commercial reach.
  • Focus Areas: Functional silica materials, battery-related separator materials, and emerging aerogel thermal-insulation applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Functional silica and specialty silica materials
  • Battery-separator related silica solutions
  • Public Aerogel Product Reference: Industry-source reporting states that the company has developed aerogel products mainly for insulation applications, but a dedicated aerogel capacity figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official corporate site.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Presence: China-based silica-materials manufacturing operations, as presented on the official corporate site.
  • International Certifications: The reviewed official pages do not clearly list aerogel-specific international certification details.
  • Official Website: https://www.gz-silica.com/cn/

FAQ

Why is Jinsanjiang included in an aerogel directory?

Public industry reporting indicates that Jinsanjiang has developed aerogel products for insulation uses, while the official corporate site confirms the company’s broader silica-materials manufacturing business.

What is Jinsanjiang mainly known for?

The company is primarily known for functional silica materials and related advanced-material solutions, with aerogel described as an emerging product direction in public industry-source materials.

Is a specific aerogel output figure public?

A dedicated aerogel production-capacity figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official corporate pages.
